india.one_line: India advances AI infrastructure, data privacy enforcement, and regulatory scrutiny over home video collection.

themes.title: MeitY scrutinizes video data and opens consent portal
themes.text: MeitY questioned home services platforms regarding in-home video data collection for physical AI models and launched a consent manager registration portal under the DPDP Act.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI
MeitY opens DPDP Act consent manager registration portal

themes.title: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 crore for data centre
themes.text: ReNew Energy Global announced an ₹80,000 crore investment in Andhra Pradesh to build a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean energy manufacturing facilities.

stories.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh

themes.title: NITI Aayog warns of AI capital concentration
themes.text: NITI Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warned that the concentration of capital, influence, and circular financing among a few companies poses systemic risks to the AI industry.

stories.headline: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration
